text: Business Checking Basic has a monthly maintenance fee of $15. The fee is waived when the minimum daily balance is $2,500 or more. The account includes 150 free transactions each month, then $0.40 per transaction. The opening deposit is $100.

Business Checking Plus has a monthly maintenance fee of $30. The fee is waived when the average monthly balance is $10,000 or more. The account includes 300 free transactions each month, then $0.35 per transaction. The opening deposit is $250.

Business Savings pays 1.20% APY on balances under $25,000 and 2.10% APY on balances of $25,000 or more. The monthly fee is $5 and is waived with a $1,000 minimum daily balance. Withdrawals are limited to 6 per month, then $10 each.

A 12-month Business CD pays 3.40% APY and a 24-month Business CD pays 3.65% APY. The minimum opening deposit is $5,000. The early withdrawal penalty is 90 days of interest on the 12-month CD and 180 days of interest on the 24-month CD.
Outgoing domestic wires cost $25 and outgoing international wires cost $45. Incoming domestic wires have no fee. Incoming international wires cost $15.
Cash deposits are free up to $10,000 per month. Above that, the fee is 0.30% of the amount over $10,000.

The Business Credit Card has no annual fee. The introductory APR is 0% for the first 9 months, then a variable APR of 17.99% to 25.99%. Cash back is 1.5% on all purchases. The foreign transaction fee is 3%.

The Business Line of Credit offers limits from $10,000 to $250,000. The rate is variable, from prime plus 2.50% to prime plus 6.00%. The annual fee is $150. Applicants need at least 2 years in business. The line is not offered in Nevada or Vermont.
A Term Loan ranges from $25,000 to $500,000 with terms of 12 to 60 months. Fixed rates run from 7.25% to 12.75%. The origination fee is 1.5% of the loan amount. There is no prepayment penalty.

An Equipment Loan finances up to 80% of the equipment cost, so the down payment is at least 20%. Terms run up to 36 months. Fixed rates run from 6.90% to 11.40%. The Equipment Loan is available in every state except Hawaii and Alaska.

To open a business account, bring your formation documents, an EIN confirmation letter, and a government photo ID for each owner. You can open an account online or in a branch. Business Checking Basic needs a $100 opening deposit.
Phone support is available Monday to Friday, 8 a.m. to 8 p.m. Eastern. Online chat is available 24 hours a day.
